title: Delightful and tasty!
text: This was an amazing tour. It was super easy to find Rocio at the meeting point. From the beginning she had great stories to tell us about each place. The food was tasty. I especially like the Spanish omelet and the Russian salad! There was some walking but it was not long and each place was ready for our arrival and had great service. The group was also great. We tried new foods and drinks and made new friends. Thank you for the fun!
